lines.en: "What is this? What happened here?"
"I don't know."
"Oh, this does not look good."
"Did anyone see what happened around my desk area this morning?"
"Dwett, I really think someone's probably just playing a prank on you, so just go right through it."
"A prank, huh? This is official police line tape, okay? It's not a prank."
"Probably is."
"Mmm, nothing much is happening today. We are having photo IDs taken. Whoop-dee-doo. Can't always be like The Apprentice."
"I know."
"On Big Brother, something important happens every day, but real life is not like that."
"Damn it, people! Someone must have seen something!"
"Oh, you people are useless. Jesus."
"Thunder Mifflin, this is Pam."
"Hold, please. Dwight, it's the sheriff. He said that it's really important that it's regarding your desk. I'll transfer."
"Oh, no, no, don't! Can I -- I can't --"
"I hate it when people don't tell each other why they're angry.
"My dad was like that."
"I can't --"
"Oh, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
You're a deputy, you're a deputy, and you're a deputy, and you are not."
"That is not why."
"Wow, man, he really wants to get in touch with you. Maybe it's a murder."
"No, there's no blood."
"Maybe poison?"
"Possibly."
"My God!"
"No, no, no, no. Sheriff, this is Volunteer Sheriff's Deputy Dwight Schrute. Press the pound key. What's your 20?"
"What's your 20?"
"There is this old story about two women who each think they are the mother of this baby, and they can't decide.
So they bring the baby to a wise man, just like a manager in those days.
And the wise man says, 'I will adopt this baby, and raise it as a Hindu.'"
"See? They didn't expect that. And that fixed it. Because I think he was the dad, anyway."
"Okay. Here we go. One, two..."
"He sometimes wears glasses. Write that down. Also, that may not be his real hair."
"Cage match? I don't... I don't know if it was in the packet from corporate, because I barely read any of it."
"So if you're asking if I stole their idea, the answer is no."
"That's not bad. Hey, do you do weddings?"
"Would you seriously want your wedding photos to look like that?"
"Not bad."
"I gave her a higher clearance than you."
"What does level red mean?"
"I'd tell you, but I'd have to kill you."
"No, wait."
"No, wait."
"Yeah."
"You must have mis-dialed. This is Phyllis."
"No, I'm not sure what his extension is."
"Wow. I never thought Dwight would go postal. It's always a person you least expect, and I always thought Dwight would go postal."
"Come on, Dwight. I think it's actually healthy to get it off your chest."
"I'm done talking. I am a shrewd. We don't back down."
"You're arrogant and pompous, and I don't like you."
"I'm the one who petitioned the office park to have these ID badges taken."
"Oh, so there were no death threats?"
"Let me see your ID."
"Excuse me, sir."
"Dowight Shrewd, is that your real name?"
"Yes, sir."
"Morning."
"Morning."
"Okay, go ahead."
"No, come on."
"There are dozens of old complaints in here. Cold cases, like the show."
"Gung, gung."
"And Toby is a lazy detective who has decided that these armed robberies and rapes and murder suicides are not important enough to solve."
"Well, you know what? I have a problem with that. And I'm going to open up these cases before Toby can kill or rape another person."
